projects.name: SunSpec Bridge
projects.summary: Serve existing SunSpec2 inverter readings to FEMS/OpenEMS over Modbus TCP.
projects.requires: SunSpec2; a reachable inverter; FEMS/OpenEMS client

projects.name: Dreame Live Camera
projects.summary: PIN-gated live video from compatible Dreame/MOVA robot vacuums.
projects.requires: Configured dreame_vacuum integration; supported camera; camera PIN

projects.name: Philips Avent Baby Monitor
projects.summary: Baby-monitor video, temperature, night light, lullabies and alerts; includes LAN bridge apps.
projects.requires: Compatible Philips Avent monitor; account provisioning; selected bridge app

projects.name: Bunker Codex
projects.summary: Use an existing Codex HTTPS bridge as a native Home Assistant Assist conversation agent.
projects.requires: Existing compatible HTTPS bridge; bridge token; trusted TLS certificate

projects.name: Dahoam Vacuum Card
projects.summary: Vacuum map, cleaning controls, room selection and dock controls in a compact card.
projects.requires: Configured vacuum integration and explicitly selected entities

projects.name: Motion Tracker Card
projects.summary: Show recent detections on configurable vector floor plans using HA entities and recorder history.
projects.requires: Motion/presence entities or timestamp/event helpers; configured floor geometry

projects.name: MeinVodafone fork
projects.summary: Reference to the personal fork of the Vodafone Germany contract-usage integration.
projects.requires: Vodafone DE account; inspect fork changes/releases before switching source

projects.name: Shinobi (legacy)
projects.summary: Original YAML-based Shinobi CCTV camera integration retained in this repository.
projects.requires: Shinobi API/group keys and MJPEG streams; current HA compatibility unverified
